entities.title: Tests on Linux and macOS
entities.summary: The unit tests run with the rest of the workspace in CI, on Linux, and in the release's macOS build on the owner's Mac.
criteria: cargo test -p shell-tools passes on both platforms.

checks.description: CI's test stage and the release's macOS build run it within cargo test --workspace.

entities.title: Coverage gate
entities.summary: CI's coverage stage gates the library at 95% of lines and 95% of branches, test code excluded.
criteria: Line and branch coverage of shell-tools are each at least 95%.
Test modules and the test Host are excluded with coverage(off).

checks.description: The coverage stage of ci.sh (continuous_integration_and_delivery) runs it with a 95% line and branch gate, by hand, on Linux.

entities.title: Operations through the daemon
entities.summary: The daemon's own tests run every operation through its real Host and its sessions.
criteria: See json-calls in the daemon's command verification.
